name: writing
title: Writing and blog
summary: Posts in your voice, fact-checked, and published only when you say so.

rules.text: Every fact in a post links to where it came from.
rules.why: a reader who cannot see where a fact came from has to take your word for it.

rules.text: A post publishes only after you approve it.
rules.why: a post goes out under your name, so you decide when it is ready.

items.title: Every fact in a post links to where it came from
items.criterion: Every fact a post marks carries a link to where it came from. test/post-sources.test.js reads each post, fails on a marked fact without a link, and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- posts/
- test/post-sources.test.js
Test:
- test/post-sources.test.js reads every post and fails on a marked fact without a link

items.title: A post publishes only after you approve it
items.criterion: A post is published only when it records your approval, and the publish step refuses a post without it. test/post-approval.test.js tries to publish an unapproved post, expects a refusal, and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- the publish step
- test/post-approval.test.js
Test:
- test/post-approval.test.js runs the publish step on an unapproved post and expects it to refuse, without publishing anything
